speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; to help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if they happen at rest or when you are using your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's disease with early dementia.

I have noted that the tremor is progressive and affects tasks requiring steadiness, and your wife reports a decline in memory and finances. To confirm the diagnosis and assess the severity of the motor and cognitive issues, I need to see the results of a neurological exam and brain imaging. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain.
